markets.question: Fed Rate Cut in 2026?
markets.description:
This market will settle to Yes if the United States Federal Reserve decreases the upper bound of the target range for the federal funds rate by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Outcome sourced from the Federal Reserve.

Rate changes taken at scheduled FOMC meetings or at unscheduled or emergency meetings will both qualify.
markets.title: Cut

markets.question: Fed Decision in October
markets.description:
This market will settle to Yes if the Federal Reserve decreases the upper bound of the target federal funds rate by 50 basis points or more at the October 2026 Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting, currently scheduled for October 27-28. Outcome sourced from the Federal Reserve.

If the change in the specified rate does not precisely match the displayed options, changes smaller than the smallest option of the same direction (increase/decrease) will be rounded to that smallest option, and changes greater than the smallest option of the same direction will be rounded to the nearest displayed option, with values exactly halfway between options being rounded away from zero.

markets.question: US GDP Growth in Q3 2026?
markets.description:
This market will settle to Yes if the seasonally adjusted annualized rate of real U.S. GDP growth for Q3 2026 is above 2.5%. Outcome sourced from the Bureau of Economic Analysis. 

Settlement is based on the Advance Estimate GDP release published by the BEA, currently scheduled for October 29, 2026. Any subsequent revisions to this figure will not be considered for settlement purposes.

If the figure is not published on the scheduled date, the first officially published Q3 2026 figure will be used. If no qualifying GDP figure is released within three months of the Advance Estimate GDP scheduled release date, this market will resolve based on data from the most recent previous quarter with available data.
markets.title: Above 2.5%

markets.question: CPI MoM in September
markets.description:
This market will settle to Yes if the one-month percent change in the seasonally adjusted Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI MoM) for September 2026 is above 0.6%. Outcome sourced from BLS. 

Settlement is based on the Consumer Price Index release published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), currently scheduled for release on October 14, 2026. Any subsequent revisions to this figure will not be considered for settlement purposes.

If the BLS does not publish CPI MoM for September 2026 on the Consumer Price Index scheduled release date, the first figure officially published by BLS for CPI MoM in September 2026 will be used for settlement. If no qualifying figure is published within three months of the scheduled release date, this market will resolve based on data from the most recent previous month with available data.
markets.title: Above 0.6%

markets.question: US GDP Growth in 2026?
markets.description:
This market will settle to Yes if the rate of real U.S. GDP growth for 2026 is above 3.4%. Outcome sourced from the Bureau of Economic Analysis. 

The rate of real U.S. GDP growth for 2026 refers to the comparison between the annual level of GDP for 2025 and the annual level of GDP for 2026. Settlement is based on the Q4 Advance Estimate GDP release published by the BEA, currently scheduled for early 2027. Any subsequent revisions to this figure will not be considered for settlement purposes.

If the figure is not published on the scheduled date, the first officially published figure for the rate of real U.S. GDP growth in 2026 will be used. If no qualifying GDP figure is released within three months of the Advance Estimate GDP scheduled release date, this market will resolve based on data from the most recent previous release with available data.
markets.title: Above 3.4%
